name: Canva UI Ontology
description: Comprehensive hierarchical ontology and semantic UI registry for the Canva Web and Desktop editor interface.

source_provenance.primary: Official Canva Help Center & Editor Documentation (https://www.canva.com/help/)
source_provenance.secondary: Canva Magic Studio Design Guides & DOM Bridge telemetry

layout_regions.name: Top Global Navigation Bar
layout_regions.description: Top bar containing Home, File, Resize & Magic Switch, Undo/Redo, Title, Share, and Download.

layout_regions.name: Left Primary Tool Navigation
layout_regions.description: Vertical icon strip on the far left: Design/Templates, Elements, Text, Brand, Uploads, Draw, Projects, Apps.

layout_regions.name: Left Expanding Tool Panel / Magic Studio
layout_regions.description: Flyout sidebar opened when clicking a tool on the left or contextual tools like 'Edit photo' or 'Animate'.

layout_regions.name: Contextual Floating Editor Toolbar
layout_regions.description: Horizontal bar floating directly above the canvas or docked below the header, showing tools relevant to the selected element (e.g. Edit photo, BG Remover, Eraser, Crop, Flip, Animate, Position, Transparency).

layout_regions.name: Central Design Canvas Workspace
layout_regions.description: The central interactive viewport displaying the design pages, artboards, and user assets.

layout_regions.name: Bottom Editor Controls Bar
layout_regions.description: Footer bar containing Notes, Timer, Page Thumbnails, Zoom Slider, Grid View, and Fullscreen toggle.

visual_features: Photographic or vector graphic placed on white/colored artboard
When selected: bounded by a bright purple outline (#8B3DFF / #7D2AE8) with 8 corner/edge resize handles and floating quick-action pill

ui_changes: Purple selection box appears around object
Top contextual toolbar displays 'Edit photo' (or 'Edit'), 'BG Remover', 'Crop', 'Flip', 'Animate', 'Position'

visual_features: Pill button with text 'Edit photo' or 'Edit'
Located at the far left of the contextual toolbar directly above the canvas workspace

ui_changes: Left sidebar expands showing 'Magic Studio' / 'Effects' tab
Tools visible: 'BG Remover', 'Magic Eraser', 'Magic Edit', 'Magic Grab', 'Adjust', 'Filters', 'Effects', 'Mockups'

visual_features: Square tool card with beach-ball icon or cutout portrait icon
Label 'BG Remover' with small gold Pro crown icon in top-right corner of the button card

ui_changes: Canva shows progress animation/spinner on canvas asset
Subject on canvas becomes isolated with transparent background
Undo button activates in top global navigation bar

visual_features: Button with sparkle / moving squares icon and label 'Animate' (or name of currently applied animation, e.g. 'Fade', 'Pan')

ui_changes: Left sidebar expands displaying Animation styles tab ('Basic', 'Scale', 'Exaggerate', 'Motion Effects')

visual_features: Square thumbnail icon illustrating gradual opacity fade with label 'Fade'

ui_changes: Fade button highlighted with purple border/fill in animation panel
Animation controls (Speed, Direction) appear below style grid

visual_features: Button labeled 'Position' in top contextual toolbar

ui_changes: Left sidebar opens showing 'Arrange' and 'Layers' tabs
Alignment options (Forward, Backward, To front, To back, Align to page) displayed

visual_features: Primary action button on the top-right of the screen, dark or purple fill with label 'Share'

ui_changes: Dropdown modal opens showing collaboration links, Download, Template link, Social media, and Print

visual_features: Option inside Share menu with tray-arrow icon and text 'Download'

ui_changes: Download configuration panel displays file type selector (PNG, JPG, PDF, MP4), size slider, and purple Download button
